summary: No runbook rebuilds a prd VM with -replace any more: the OpenBao recovery, srviac rebuild and cluster-member flows destroy the VM on Proxmox with qm destroy, then apply, and the prd recovery notes (vm-rebuild.md, plus k8s-rebuild.md:248) clear a tainted VM the same way. The scratch flows keep -replace, and iac-agent.md's guard description no longer names VMs. Committed b681222 on phase/017-P4; the root gate has no test statements and ran nothing.
